title: Judgment Review
summary: This section covers the respondent's request for a judicial review of the registrar's decision, leading to a dismissal of the appellant's application by Wilcox CJ.
content: On 12 April 1995, the respondent moved the Court for an order that the decision of the registrar be reviewed by a judge of the Court pursuant to s 377(2) of the Act. The review proceeding was heard before his Honour on 1 June 1995 and reasons for judgment were delivered on that day. Again the appellant appeared on his own behalf. As in the hearing before the registrar the respondent was represented by counsel.
